subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is Wen Zheng in his underworld judge form, from <Picture 1>: cold, severe, pale, sharp dark eyes, high dark ponytail with silver-white streaks, black skull-lotus crown with green jade, black obsidian and blood-red high-collared robe, silver skeletal lace, blue runes, translucent ghost chains, ten beast-head rings, talisman tassels, small bronze bell. Ignore the studio background and multiple views.
<Subject 2> is Bi'an, from <Picture 2>: a young adult East Asian woman with a youthful round face, bright dark eyes, pale skin, elaborate braided updo with white floral pins and pearl drops, long pearl earrings, pale mint-green and white silk gown, floral appliqués, pearl chains, and a long high-slit skirt. She holds a black-covered ledger. Natural live-action skin, not porcelain CG. Ignore the studio background and multiple views.
<Subject 3> is the stone prison cell from <Picture 3>: dark damp stone walls, a heavy wooden door left, a plain wooden table with two chairs, a narrow wooden bed right, a small high barred window with a single shaft of cold moonlight. No chains, no torture instruments, no people.
<Subject 4> is Chen Yanqiu, from <Picture 4>: a middle-aged East Asian scholar, thin and pale, long tired face, deep-set dark eyes, neat scholar's bun, faded gray-green robe perfectly pressed, collar straight, long ink-stained fingers, no shackles. His back is straight, his chin slightly lifted.

summary:
[reference generation] Chen finishes his bitter answer; Wen Zheng pulls the left chair out, sits, and taps the table, while Bi'an remains behind his shoulder.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1>: partially_preserved - face, hair, crown, robe, ghost chains, rings, and bell are preserved; his sitting down and table tap are newly generated.
<Subject 2>: partially_preserved - face, hair ornaments, jewelry, dress, and ledger are preserved; her shift behind his chair is newly generated.
<Subject 3>: partially_preserved - cell geometry, moonlight, table, chairs, and bed are preserved; the chair scrape and camera move are newly generated.
<Subject 4>: partially_preserved - face, hair, robe, and seated posture are preserved; his finished line and watching gaze are newly generated.

detailed_description:
Photorealistic live-action dark-fantasy interior, cold blue-gray moonlight, deep stone shadows, natural 35mm lens, soft filmic contrast, fine grain, realistic stone, wood, fabric, and skin, 16:9 widescreen. No captions, no subtitles, no watermarks, no graphic overlays.
[Shot 1] A medium close-up on Chen, <Subject 4>, seated in the right chair, hands on his knees. He finishes the sentence with a thin, bitter calm: <Subject 4> (S4) <d>[Chinese] 不过是有人怕我多说几句真话，碍了某些人的眼罢了。</d> The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed. His eyes stay on Wen Zheng.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.500, the shot cuts to a low medium shot of Wen Zheng, <Subject 1>, at the left chair. He pulls the chair out, sits, and leans forward, one hand on the table; his fingers tap the wood twice. Bi'an, <Subject 2>, remains behind his left shoulder, the ledger against her chest. Chen watches him sit without changing expression.
At the end of the clip, Wen Zheng is seated in the left chair, leaning slightly forward, one hand on the table; Chen is seated in the right chair, hands on his knees; Bi'an stands behind Wen Zheng's left shoulder, the ledger against her chest. The table remains between the two men.

overall_soundscape:
The chair legs scraping stone, the soft tap of fingers on wood, the rustle of robes, and the faint chime of the bronze bell at Wen Zheng's waist. No other voices.

non_diegetic_music: N/A
